spec.title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
spec.summary: Return a binary tree's values grouped by depth, beginning with the root.
spec.description: Return a binary tree's values grouped by depth, beginning with the root. Within each depth group, list values from left to right. An empty tree yields an empty outer list.

examples.explanation: The last two nodes are on the same depth.
An empty tree has no levels.

approaches.name: Visit One Level at a Time
approaches.summary: Use a queue and its current size to group nodes by depth.
thinkingSteps: Return an empty list for an absent root.
For each queue batch, record exactly the nodes currently at that depth.
Enqueue their children from left to right for the next batch.

bullets: The output is divided by depth.
Values within a level must go left to right.
A queue naturally keeps the current frontier together.
